assets_has_owner.name: assets_has_owner
assets_has_owner.value: "assets"."project_id" is not null or "assets"."user_id" is not null

reel_analysis_ranges.name: reel_analysis_ranges
reel_analysis_ranges.value:
"reel_analysis"."duration_sec" > 0 and "reel_analysis"."cut_pace" >= 0
        and ("reel_analysis"."hook_timing_sec" is null or "reel_analysis"."hook_timing_sec" >= 0)
        and ("reel_analysis"."engagement_score" is null or ("reel_analysis"."engagement_score" >= 0 and "reel_analysis"."engagement_score" <= 100))

reel_metrics_counts_nonneg.name: reel_metrics_counts_nonneg
reel_metrics_counts_nonneg.value:
coalesce("reel_metrics"."views", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("reel_metrics"."reach", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("reel_metrics"."likes", 0) >= 0
        and coalesce("reel_metrics"."comments", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("reel_metrics"."saves", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("reel_metrics"."shares", 0) >= 0

reel_metrics_ranges.name: reel_metrics_ranges
reel_metrics_ranges.value:
("reel_metrics"."avg_watch_sec" is null or "reel_metrics"."avg_watch_sec" >= 0)
        and ("reel_metrics"."avg_watch_pct" is null or ("reel_metrics"."avg_watch_pct" >= 0 and "reel_metrics"."avg_watch_pct" <= 100))
        and ("reel_metrics"."skip_rate" is null or ("reel_metrics"."skip_rate" >= 0 and "reel_metrics"."skip_rate" <= 1))

reels_source_shape.name: reels_source_shape
reels_source_shape.value: ("reels"."source" = 'instagram') = ("reels"."account_id" is not null and "reels"."external_id" is not null)
